slug: 2026-04-03 Ghana approves $250M AI Hub & National AI Strategy

facts.fact: Africa AI News reports that Ghana's Cabinet approved the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, a ten-year strategy with eight pillars, with public launch set for 24 April 2026; the date is the document's published date, as it gives only 'on Tuesday'.
The document says a dedicated Responsible AI Office will oversee implementation of the strategy, coordinating sectors and monitoring progress.

note: Computing centre ($250m) is not tied to the strategy as its funded action; the document gives the strategy period as 2023-2033.
